Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, blunt bob auburn hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of four stacked horizontal electric-cyan neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, joined by one short vertical tube between them, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of electric-blue neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: standing just behind the foreground landmark with one forearm resting on top of it, weight on one leg, the other hand on her hip, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy pearl champagne leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in pearl champagne lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large hoop earrings of polished gold with blackened iron accents as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, the limestone karst islands of Ha Long Bay covered in green jungle, with traditional red-sailed junk boats on the emerald water placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny junk boats and tiny kayaks around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the shallow emerald bay water, a soft misty morning sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft diffused morning light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
